target_customer: Independent art, music and activist event organizers and spaces
problem: Independent venues and organizers struggle to fund spaces and convert attendees into recurring supporters.
business_model: Platform fees on ticketing and memberships

founders.name: Joe Ahearn
founders.background_notes: YC page: began organizing underground music spaces in New York

technical_complexity.rationale: Ticketing, payments and membership checkout; standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Ticketing platforms were easy to replicate; community trust was the main asset.

market_need_then: Not documented by dated sources; Crunchbase text says 3,000 memberships bought in the first year (unverified snippet).

branding.name_origin: Withfriends name unexplained; Pools name unexplained

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, 'made by DIY event organizers with love'

rebrands.why: Not stated; Pools site shows image paths still named withfriends

branding.community_and_virality: Pools confusable with UK betting brand The Pools (unrelated)

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name with search confusion against an unrelated UK brand; no brand press.

pivots.to: Pools memberships platform for event organizers

outcome_analysis: Pools remains a tiny team of 2 on the YC page with no public funding beyond aggregator entries of small amounts. It rebranded from Withfriends and shifted toward memberships for event organizers; no exit or shutdown found, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: Unverified aggregator funding: $150K YC seed Mar 2019 (Bounce Watch), PitchBook $107K crowdfunding Nov 2018 and $17.6K Oct 2023. Founding year conflicts (2015, 2016, 2017). Co-founder Martha Hipley appears only on a Crunchbase snippet; not listed. Competitors empty: no dated source found. Downgraded to depth 1 by orchestrator: the researcher reported combining the outcome and branding searches.
